training: 120,000-step DQN, one seed, reference replay seeding and behavior-cloning auxiliary loss
descent_rule: 900 kPa stopping-distance rule; below 20 m, track 1+sqrt(4h) m/s downward-speed envelope
limitation: DQN alone is evaluated separately and does not meet the landing criteria. CFD nozzle map and point-mass flight model are educational approximations.
